role_summary: Own Q1, Q3, and Q5 by proposing concrete SQLite tables that preserve heterogeneous evidence semantics, units, measurement bases, applicability, and provenance.
recommendation: Use a normalized, typed long-form evidence schema—not a wide crop table or unconstrained EAV. Store one atomic assertion per row, attach a controlled semantic role, scope, and provenance, place numbers in a constrained interval child, and group compound assertions; keep measurement basis separate from unit and publish non-overlapping target, experiment, and hazard views.
why: Basil alone has an optimum range, experimental temperatures, a base temperature, injury thresholds, and disease conditions for the same logical axis.
Lettuce confirms that repeated metrics vary by cultivar, system, stage, and evidentiary meaning; one column per crop-axis would lose those distinctions.
Composite foreign keys make lux, PPFD, DLI, VWC, field-capacity fraction, and the EC bases structurally non-interchangeable.
Atomic rows avoid sparse migrations while constrained numeric forms retain substantially more safety than generic EAV values.
schema_sketch:
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

-- Provenance and crop identity
CREATE TABLE crop (
  crop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  common_name_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE source_document (
  document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER,
  path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  format_version TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crop(crop_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE source_document_revision (
  revision_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
  imported_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE (document_id, sha256),
  FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES source_document(document_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE literature_source (
  source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  authors_or_org TEXT,
  published_year INTEGER CHECK (published_year BETWEEN 1800 AND 2200),
  citation TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT,
  doi TEXT
) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_literature_source_doi
  ON literature_source(doi) WHERE doi IS NOT NULL;

-- Q5: a unit describes scale; a measurement basis describes what was measured.
CREATE TABLE physical_quantity (
  quantity_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  canonical_unit_symbol TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE unit (
  unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  quantity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
  scale_to_canonical REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK (scale_to_canonical > 0),
  offset_to_canonical REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
  UNIQUE (quantity_id, unit_code),
  UNIQUE (unit_id, quantity_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (quantity_id) REFERENCES physical_quantity(quantity_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE metric (
  metric_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  metric_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  hardware_channel_code TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE measurement_basis (
  basis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  basis_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sampled_material TEXT NOT NULL,
  method_note TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (basis_id, metric_id, quantity_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric(metric_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (quantity_id) REFERENCES physical_quantity(quantity_id)
) STRICT;

-- Applicability: empty membership means unspecified, never universal.
CREATE TABLE cultivar (
  cultivar_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (crop_id, name),
  UNIQUE (cultivar_id, crop_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crop(crop_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE cultivation_system (
  system_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  system_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE growth_stage (
  stage_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  stage_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label_ko TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE growing_medium (
  medium_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  medium_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE applicability_scope (
  scope_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cultivar_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cultivar_mode IN ('UNSPECIFIED','ALL_CROP','LISTED')),
  system_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (system_mode IN ('UNSPECIFIED','LISTED')),
  stage_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage_mode IN ('UNSPECIFIED','ALL_STAGES','LISTED')),
  medium_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (medium_mode IN ('UNSPECIFIED','LISTED')),
  scope_note TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (scope_id, crop_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crop(crop_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE scope_cultivar (
  scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cultivar_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, cultivar_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (scope_id, crop_id) REFERENCES applicability_scope(scope_id, crop_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (cultivar_id, crop_id) REFERENCES cultivar(cultivar_id, crop_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE scope_system (
  scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  system_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, system_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (scope_id) REFERENCES applicability_scope(scope_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (system_id) REFERENCES cultivation_system(system_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE scope_stage (
  scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  stage_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, stage_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (scope_id) REFERENCES applicability_scope(scope_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (stage_id) REFERENCES growth_stage(stage_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE scope_medium (
  scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  medium_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, medium_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (scope_id) REFERENCES applicability_scope(scope_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (medium_id) REFERENCES growing_medium(medium_id)
) STRICT;

-- Q3: shared claim machinery, mandatory controlled role, non-overlapping role families.
CREATE TABLE assertion_role (
  role_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  role_family TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role_family IN (
    'OPTIMUM','RECOMMENDATION','EXPERIMENT','OPERATING_CONDITION','OBSERVATION',
    'DISEASE_RISK','QUALITY_RISK','INJURY','LETHALITY','MODEL','MANAGEMENT'
  )),
  description TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO assertion_role VALUES
 ('VALIDATED_OPTIMUM','OPTIMUM','Validated optimum or optimum range'),
 ('RECOMMENDED_TARGET','RECOMMENDATION','Published crop-management target'),
 ('EXPERIMENTAL_CONDITION','EXPERIMENT','Treatment used in an experiment'),
 ('SYSTEM_OPERATING_CONDITION','OPERATING_CONDITION','Condition used to operate a studied system'),
 ('OBSERVED_RESPONSE','OBSERVATION','Observed response at a stated condition'),
 ('DISEASE_RISK_CONDITION','DISEASE_RISK','Condition enabling disease or sporulation'),
 ('QUALITY_RISK_THRESHOLD','QUALITY_RISK','Threshold associated with quality loss'),
 ('INJURY_THRESHOLD','INJURY','Threshold associated with physiological injury'),
 ('LETHALITY_THRESHOLD','LETHALITY','Directly evidenced mortality threshold'),
 ('BASE_TEMPERATURE','MODEL','Model parameter, not a safe minimum'),
 ('IRRIGATION_TRIGGER','MANAGEMENT','Basis-specific irrigation trigger');

CREATE TABLE evidence_status (
  status_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  blocks_target_use INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocks_target_use IN (0,1)),
  blocks_risk_use INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocks_risk_use IN (0,1)),
  requires_scope_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requires_scope_match IN (0,1)),
  requires_basis_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requires_basis_match IN (0,1))
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO evidence_status VALUES
 ('no_direct_evidence','No directly applicable value found',1,1,0,0),
 ('cultivar_specific','Specific cultivar only',0,0,1,0),
 ('system_specific','Specific cultivation system only',0,0,1,0),
 ('stage_specific','Specific growth stage only',0,0,1,0),
 ('general_crop_reference','Broader crop-group reference',1,1,0,0),
 ('experimental_condition_only','Treatment, not validated target',1,1,0,0),
 ('measurement_not_transferable','Different measurement basis',0,0,0,1),
 ('not_a_risk_threshold','Not evidence of risk or lethality',0,1,0,0),
 ('insufficient_duration_data','No supported exposure duration',0,0,0,0),
 ('no_recovery_threshold','No supported recovery criterion',0,0,0,0);

CREATE TABLE evidence_claim (
  claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  document_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  primary_source_id INTEGER,
  metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  basis_id INTEGER,
  quantity_id INTEGER,
  role_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  assertion_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (assertion_state IN ('PRESENT','INVESTIGATED_GAP','NOT_REVIEWED')),
  value_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_mode IN ('NUMERIC','QUALITATIVE','NONE')),
  summary_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  limitations_ko TEXT,
  UNIQUE (claim_id, quantity_id),
  CHECK ((basis_id IS NULL AND quantity_id IS NULL) OR
         (basis_id IS NOT NULL AND quantity_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (value_mode <> 'NUMERIC' OR basis_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (
    (assertion_state = 'PRESENT' AND value_mode IN ('NUMERIC','QUALITATIVE') AND primary_source_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (assertion_state IN ('INVESTIGATED_GAP','NOT_REVIEWED') AND value_mode = 'NONE' AND primary_source_id IS NULL)
  ),
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crop(crop_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (scope_id, crop_id) REFERENCES applicability_scope(scope_id, crop_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (document_revision_id) REFERENCES source_document_revision(revision_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (primary_source_id) REFERENCES literature_source(source_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric(metric_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (basis_id, metric_id, quantity_id)
    REFERENCES measurement_basis(basis_id, metric_id, quantity_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (role_code) REFERENCES assertion_role(role_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_status (
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (claim_id, status_code),
  FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES evidence_claim(claim_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (status_code) REFERENCES evidence_status(status_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_source (
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('SUPPORTS','CONTEXT','LIMITATION')),
  source_locator TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (claim_id, source_id, relation),
  FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES evidence_claim(claim_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES literature_source(source_id)
) STRICT;

-- Compound conditions and treatment series remain atomic claims joined explicitly.
CREATE TABLE claim_group (
  group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  group_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (group_type IN ('AND','OR','SERIES','COMPARISON')),
  label TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE claim_group_member (
  group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  member_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  member_role TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (group_id, claim_id),
  UNIQUE (group_id, member_order),
  FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES claim_group(group_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES evidence_claim(claim_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) STRICT;

-- Typed numeric child: point, interval, or one-sided threshold; never arbitrary EAV text.
CREATE TABLE numeric_value (
  claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  quantity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  value_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_form IN ('POINT','RANGE','LOWER_BOUND','UPPER_BOUND')),
  lower_value REAL,
  upper_value REAL,
  lower_inclusive INTEGER CHECK (lower_inclusive IN (0,1)),
  upper_inclusive INTEGER CHECK (upper_inclusive IN (0,1)),
  uncertainty_value REAL CHECK (uncertainty_value >= 0),
  is_approximate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_approximate IN (0,1)),
  original_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (lower_inclusive IS NULL OR lower_value IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (upper_inclusive IS NULL OR upper_value IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (uncertainty_value IS NULL OR value_form = 'POINT'),
  CHECK (
    (value_form = 'POINT' AND lower_value IS NOT NULL AND upper_value IS NULL)
    OR (value_form = 'RANGE' AND lower_value IS NOT NULL AND upper_value IS NOT NULL AND lower_value <= upper_value)
    OR (value_form = 'LOWER_BOUND' AND lower_value IS NOT NULL AND upper_value IS NULL)
    OR (value_form = 'UPPER_BOUND' AND lower_value IS NULL AND upper_value IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, quantity_id) REFERENCES evidence_claim(claim_id, quantity_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (source_unit_id, quantity_id) REFERENCES unit(unit_id, quantity_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER numeric_value_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON numeric_value
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM evidence_claim c
    WHERE c.claim_id = NEW.claim_id
      AND c.assertion_state = 'PRESENT'
      AND c.value_mode = 'NUMERIC'
      AND c.quantity_id = NEW.quantity_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'numeric_value requires a PRESENT NUMERIC claim') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER numeric_value_update_guard
BEFORE UPDATE ON numeric_value
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM evidence_claim c
    WHERE c.claim_id = NEW.claim_id
      AND c.assertion_state = 'PRESENT'
      AND c.value_mode = 'NUMERIC'
      AND c.quantity_id = NEW.quantity_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'numeric_value requires a PRESENT NUMERIC claim') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER claim_cannot_demote_numeric
BEFORE UPDATE OF assertion_state, value_mode, quantity_id ON evidence_claim
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM numeric_value n WHERE n.claim_id = OLD.claim_id)
 AND (NEW.assertion_state <> 'PRESENT' OR NEW.value_mode <> 'NUMERIC' OR NEW.quantity_id IS NOT OLD.quantity_id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'remove numeric_value before changing numeric claim semantics');
END;

-- Pure unit normalization is legal only within quantity_id. Basis remains in the comparison key.
CREATE VIEW v_numeric_evidence AS
SELECT c.claim_id, cr.slug AS crop_slug, m.metric_code, b.basis_code,
       q.quantity_code, r.role_code, r.role_family,
       n.value_form, n.lower_value, n.upper_value,
       n.lower_inclusive, n.upper_inclusive, n.uncertainty_value,
       n.is_approximate, u.unit_code AS original_unit, n.original_text,
       CASE WHEN n.lower_value IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE n.lower_value * u.scale_to_canonical + u.offset_to_canonical END AS canonical_lower,
       CASE WHEN n.upper_value IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE n.upper_value * u.scale_to_canonical + u.offset_to_canonical END AS canonical_upper,
       CASE WHEN n.uncertainty_value IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE n.uncertainty_value * u.scale_to_canonical END AS canonical_uncertainty,
       q.canonical_unit_symbol,
       m.metric_code || '|' || b.basis_code || '|' || q.quantity_code AS comparison_key,
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM claim_status cs JOIN evidence_status es USING(status_code)
         WHERE cs.claim_id = c.claim_id AND es.requires_scope_match = 1
       ) AS requires_exact_scope,
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM claim_status cs JOIN evidence_status es USING(status_code)
         WHERE cs.claim_id = c.claim_id AND es.requires_basis_match = 1
       ) AS requires_exact_basis
FROM evidence_claim c
JOIN numeric_value n USING(claim_id)
JOIN crop cr USING(crop_id)
JOIN metric m USING(metric_id)
JOIN measurement_basis b USING(basis_id)
JOIN physical_quantity q USING(quantity_id)
JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id = n.source_unit_id
JOIN assertion_role r USING(role_code);

CREATE VIEW v_growth_target_evidence AS
SELECT v.*
FROM v_numeric_evidence v
JOIN evidence_claim c USING(claim_id)
JOIN assertion_role r USING(role_code)
WHERE r.role_family IN ('OPTIMUM','RECOMMENDATION')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM claim_status cs JOIN evidence_status es USING(status_code)
    WHERE cs.claim_id = c.claim_id AND es.blocks_target_use = 1
  );

CREATE VIEW v_hazard_evidence AS
SELECT v.*
FROM v_numeric_evidence v
JOIN evidence_claim c USING(claim_id)
JOIN assertion_role r USING(role_code)
WHERE r.role_family IN ('DISEASE_RISK','QUALITY_RISK','INJURY','LETHALITY')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM claim_status cs JOIN evidence_status es USING(status_code)
    WHERE cs.claim_id = c.claim_id AND es.blocks_risk_use = 1
  );

CREATE VIEW v_curation_errors AS
SELECT c.claim_id, 'NUMERIC_CLAIM_WITHOUT_VALUE' AS error_code
FROM evidence_claim c
WHERE c.assertion_state = 'PRESENT' AND c.value_mode = 'NUMERIC'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM numeric_value n WHERE n.claim_id = c.claim_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT c.claim_id, 'PRESENT_MARKED_NO_DIRECT_EVIDENCE'
FROM evidence_claim c JOIN claim_status cs USING(claim_id)
WHERE c.assertion_state = 'PRESENT' AND cs.status_code = 'no_direct_evidence';

-- Worked mappings from the inspected basil source:
-- 25–30 °C: VALIDATED_OPTIMUM + AIR_AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE + RANGE.
-- 35 °C Nufar treatment: EXPERIMENTAL_CONDITION; link its OBSERVED_RESPONSE in a COMPARISON group.
-- canopy RH >=85%: DISEASE_RISK_CONDITION, never a growth-target row.
-- node base 8.2 °C: BASE_TEMPERATURE, never a safe-minimum row.
-- irrigation-water EC 1.7 dS/m: EC_IRRIGATION_WATER; it cannot share comparison_key with EC_NUTRIENT_SOLUTION.
-- field-capacity 70% irrigation trigger: FIELD_CAPACITY_FRACTION; it cannot share quantity or basis with a pot sensor index.
-- RH >95% AND duration >=7.5 h: two atomic claims in one AND group, preserving both units and bases.
scorable_axes: Air temperature — conditionally usable only where a PRESENT target claim matches crop and applicability scope.
Soil temperature — conditionally usable for an exact terrestrial stage match; hydroponic solution temperature remains a different metric and basis.
unscorable_axes: Air humidity — current numeric evidence is predominantly disease-risk evidence, not a growth optimum.
Illuminance/light — lux is neither PPFD nor DLI and the corpus supplies no defensible conversion.
CO2 concentration — no per-crop target or threshold suitable for a dashboard axis.
Particulate matter/air quality — the corpus contains no horticultural response threshold.
Noise level — the corpus provides no recognized crop-growth evidence.
Soil moisture — field-capacity fractions and system-specific VWC do not match an uncalibrated capacitive reading.
Soil temperature as a crop-wide score — available numbers are stage- or hydroponic-system-specific, not whole-cycle optima.
assumptions: Curators can split prose into atomic claims and use groups for compound conditions or treatment series.
Deployment context will eventually provide crop, cultivar, system, stage, medium, and sensor basis.
The bundled SQLite version supports STRICT tables.
risks: This row-heavy model needs more joins and disciplined seed data than a hackathon-wide table.
A curator can still assign the wrong role or basis; constraints cannot establish scientific truth.
Overly coarse bases create false comparability, while overly fine bases fragment otherwise comparable evidence.
SQLite lacks table-level roles, so consumers could bypass the safety views and query raw claims.
cheap_validation: Run one throwaway SQLite fixture encoding 25 claims from basil sections 2–5 and lettuce sections 2–5, then require zero rows in v_curation_errors and verify that inserts pairing lux with PPFD units, irrigation-water EC with nutrient-solution basis, and PRESENT experimental values with the target view are rejected or excluded; this should take under one hour.
change_mind_if: If that 25-claim fixture cannot represent at least 23 claims without crop-specific columns, lossy prose-only storage, or new numeric shapes, abandon this interval-claim core for a JSON-preserving or richer typed model.
